summary: First realized staking yield funded the reward treasury without any manual step: three keyless vaults earned yield at the Aurora pool, the reward worker harvested the city's 50 % share at epoch 5401, advanced the unstake after it unlocked at epoch 5405, and flushed the cash into questlayer-rewards-20261101.testnet, which split it 50/50 into the coin and zone buckets.

timeline.detail: worker called maintain_vault(harvest) on all three vaults; transaction hashes were not recorded before maintenance logging existed
worker called maintain_vault(advance) until the pool cash arrived; hashes not logged (logging enabled at 12:03)

reconciliation: after.funded - before.funded = sum of the three flushes = 264475212477481805278 yoctoNEAR; coin and zone buckets each received half (rounding 2 yocto to zones). Available also fell by 6000000000000000000000 per bucket because the worker published 2026-11-03 and 2026-11-04 and closed 2026-11-01 in the same period.
verify: Read get_state on each vault (game_paid) and get_treasury on the rewards contract; each flush hash is visible on https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/<hash>.
generation: 20261101 (operator questlayer-dev-20261031). On 1 November the public deployment rotated to generation 20261101b (operator questlayer-dev-20261101); the public host runs the same worker code path against that generation. This proof stays valid for the contracts it names.
